name: GstarCAD 365
tagline: Subscription-style cloud bridge for sharing drawings, sheets, and comments across teams beyond a single LAN drive.
meta_desc: Positions Gstarsoft’s ecosystem for distributed review: pair with desktop GstarCAD for authoring and use web/mobile viewers where appropriate. Confirm account, region, and retention policies on the official product pages.

terms.title: Drawing Share Link
terms.short_def: Technical best practices for Drawing Share Link inside GstarCAD 365.
terms.definition: Drawing Share Link generates access tokens for sharing drawing files, supporting comments and markup viewings.
terms.why_matters: Avoids email attachment bloat and ensures that all external partners review the same revision.
common_pitfalls: Setting unlimited link expiration, which poses data leak risks
Forgetting to verify drawing permissions before sending links to consultants

quiz.question: When working with Drawing Share Link, which of the following represents a common technical pitfall?
options: Setting unlimited link expiration, which poses data leak risks.
Failing to manually re-index the SQL server database.
Over-allocating virtual memory caches in the cloud settings.
Restricting linetype scales strictly to 1:1 paper coordinates.
quiz.explanation: Correct. A common pitfall is 'Setting unlimited link expiration, which poses data leak risks.' As the editorial review notes: 'Avoids email attachment bloat and ensures that all external partners review the same revision.'

terms.title: Version Compare Tool
terms.short_def: Technical best practices for Version Compare Tool inside GstarCAD 365.
terms.definition: Version Compare Tool highlights visual differences between drawing revisions in contrasting colors.
terms.why_matters: Speeds up sheet audits and visualizes layout modifications made by different authors.
common_pitfalls: Comparing files with different drawing coordinate baselines causing false mismatches
Neglecting to verify scale adjustments before running version compare

terms.title: Cloud Storage Sync
terms.short_def: Technical best practices for Cloud Storage Sync inside GstarCAD 365.
terms.definition: Cloud Storage Sync updates changes to GstarCAD 365 cloud servers, handling file conflicts automatically.
terms.why_matters: Keeps distributed teams aligned on the latest drawing version and prevents overwrite conflicts.
common_pitfalls: Editing files offline without checking them out first
Overwriting master revisions with old local files during force syncs

faqs.question: How do I share a drawing link with external clients?
faqs.answer: Select the file in the project manager, click Share, set permissions (view-only or edit-enabled), set expiration date, and copy the link.

faqs.question: Can I view version history and restore old revisions?
faqs.answer: Yes, GstarCAD 365 maintains a complete activity log. You can compare any two version revisions visually and restore older versions as the active drawing master.

faqs.question: Does GstarCAD 365 support offline editing?
faqs.answer: Yes, drawings can be checked out for offline work. Once you reconnect, changes are merged back as a new revision.
